one_liner: CivicState is a watchlist civic-letter workflow: built surface, unproven demand and delivery.

seedPacket.repoObserved: civicstate package and CivicState planning docs

directive: Treat as watchlist until operator resolves project identity and validates paid delivery.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record [evidence: dispatch brief]

sources: .planning/PROJECT.md [evidence: prior project context and validation targets]
methods: Inspected representative API, worker, web, and schema files
Labeled all external market claims as assumptions

planningMethod.approach: VC-grade EIR soul upgrade with explicit anti-plan and assumption ledger
planningMethod.knownStaleness: MASTER_PLAN.md says March 2026 and .planning/PROJECT.md says 2026-04-25 [evidence: repo docs]

customer.icp: US resident with a concrete civic issue, desired outcome, and ZIP code [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md]
customer.notCustomer: Enterprise advocacy teams, law firms, campaigns, filing claimants, and community/social users at launch [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md]

market.som: $54,000 launch-year revenue [assumption: 300 paid submissions/month x $15 x 12]

unitEconomics: 84% gross margin on $5 single [assumption: $0.80 modeled variable cost]
88% gross margin on $15 three-pack [assumption: $1.80 modeled variable cost]
88% gross margin on $25 full-spread [assumption: $3.00 modeled variable cost]

revenueAssumptions: Launch average package price $15 [evidence: implemented price tier; assumption: mix]
Launch volume 300 paid submissions/month [assumption: unvalidated demand]
Scale test average package price $20 [assumption: full-spread mix shift]
costAssumptions: Variable COGS 12% of revenue [assumption: 8% variable plus 4% Stripe-fee proxy]
Launch fixed costs $18,000/year [assumption: lean ops stack]
Growth fixed costs $60,000/year [assumption: support, data, compliance, contractor ops]
sensitivityTests: Downside demand: 75 paid submissions/month x $15 x 12 = $13,500 [assumption: EIR model]
Local data provider: $500/month = $6,000/year incremental fixed cost [assumption: EIR model]

alternatives: Manual email to officials [assumption: free substitute]
Resistbot [assumption: competitor category from prior plan]
Change.org [assumption: competitor category from prior plan]
LegalZoom [assumption: competitor category from prior plan]
Quorum/VoterVoice [assumption: enterprise advocacy substitutes from prior plan]

antiPlan.summary: This may be a polished demo for a low-frequency task that users expect to be free and officials may ignore.

holes.hole: Willingness to pay at $5-$25 is unproven [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md says none validated]
holes.mitigation: Run narrow paid beta before scale spend
holes.residualRisk: No viable CAC or repeat use [assumption: EIR model]

holes.hole: Local official coverage is not real because Cicero is a stub [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/officials/cicero.ts]
holes.mitigation: Manual verification or provider decision before launch
holes.residualRisk: Local issues may be the highest-intent demand [assumption: EIR model]

holes.hole: Government deliverability can fail even with Postmark [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md identifies deliverability as hardest problem]
holes.mitigation: Domain warming, bounce tracking, complaint suppression
holes.residualRisk: .gov filters may suppress AI-generated mail [assumption: EIR model]

holes.hole: Legal/compliance claims have no counsel review in workspace [evidence: legal pages exist but no counsel evidence]
holes.residualRisk: Compliance overhead can exceed revenue [assumption: EIR model]

strategy.nearTerm: Validate paid delivery loop before scaling.
strategy.platformPosture: WrkPlug client posture recommended only if operator confirms shared rails [assumption: WrkPlug Phase 0 not yet signed].
strategy.defer: Community, API, certified mail, and broad SEO scale until paid loop evidence exists [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].

goToMarket.primary: Issue/location search and narrow civic cohorts [assumption: .planning/GENESIS.md distribution hypothesis]
goToMarket.firstCohort: 30 completed previews and 10 paid submissions [assumption: beta target]

operatorWorkflow.routine: Review flagged submissions, verify official records, monitor delivery, process refunds, update evidence.
constraints: Admin pages exist for flagged items and operations [evidence: apps/web/app/admin]
Watchlist; personal/research asset unless operator confirms business pitch [evidence: registry note in dispatch]
Workspace-only research; no external source validation [evidence: dispatch]
Project identity mismatch: brooks-history dispatch vs CivicState repo contents [evidence: package.json and dispatch]

currentControls: Citation verifier strips unverified citations [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts]
AI disclosure included in drafted letters [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/drafter.ts]
Moderation before submission job enqueue [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/submissions.ts]
requiredBeforeLaunch: Human audit of 50 generated letters [assumption: QA sample]
Operator/counsel review of claims [assumption: compliance gate]

unknowns: Whether officials receive and respond to AI-assisted letters [assumption: unvalidated]
Whether local official data can be reliable [evidence: current stub]
Whether the dispatch project identity is wrong [evidence: mismatch]
Whether WrkPlug adoption is intended [assumption: operator decision needed]
